_meta.description: Example palette registry for theme-designer. Author here, then copy-on-update to dashboard/themes/ or the consuming project’s theme registry.

palettes.<id>.name: Display name
palettes.<id>.colors: Six-color set: cyan, purple, pink, indigo, blue, teal
palettes.<id>.cssFile: Suggested output filename when copied to dashboard/themes/

nameCollisions.plasma-green: Dashboard industrial green #00e879 — NOT Synagraphic Plasma Drift editor theme #e050a0 (pink). Document ids; do not conflate.

dusk-companion.name: Dusk Companion (example)
dusk-companion.aesthetic: Pink dusk — rose primary, sunset coral secondary, magenta glow on plum-black surfaces. Example only; replace when cloning.
dusk-companion.teachingNote: Public OSS dashboard ships this id in profiles/pets. Your clone should use a new id unless you are intentionally matching that profile.
